<!-- pr-reviewer: e83ec22a20389549fe019c376c721ae582ad9676 -->
**Needs changes before merge: conflicts with main, and main already landed part of #1507.**

What looks good
- Click law is consistent: plain and Ctrl take one edge (`feature_click.rs` Run unit), Shift takes loop/chain; Ctrl on an edge already covered by a stored loop removes it (`edge_pick.rs` toggle).
- Selection still goes through the existing `queue_feature_pick` / geometry-edit path (undoable); no new direct state writes.
- No snapshot PNG changed; no Cargo/build.rs/.github changes; new files under 400 lines. Decision file present, new tests pin plain/Ctrl/Shift on contour and pocket pages.

Results (locally, PR head, not merged: the trial merge conflicts)
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`: ui lib + boundary, boundary_picks, edge_loop_pick, sinker_setup, theme_files all ok (270s).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

Requested before merge
1. Merge origin/main and resolve two real conflicts, not mechanical ones: `crates/ui/src/egui_app/geo_page.rs` (~164) and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/shell.rs` (~583). Main's commit 371db9c7c already implements #1507 (row hover to viewport, `interact::row_hover_segments`, `ROW_HOVER_PX` halo, whole-row hover). Keep one implementation: drop the duplicate chip hover and either reuse main's row-hover painter in `pick_ink::paint` or replace it, so there is a single halo path. Re-run the quick gate after.
2. PR body: `Fixes #1507` should become `Refs #1507` if main's fix already covers it.

Not exercised: GUI hand test, before/after screenshots (owed for a UI change), Windows-only readings (none in the diff), Shift-hover loop preview.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: b3ddb398a4f466454c12d03447422b05b20bc231 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge (re-review of the merge of main; delta only).

What looks good
- The hand-resolved merge touches two files. In `geo_page.rs` the conflict resolves to main's #1507 version (row hover on the label, the x button and the row's other buttons; `geo_hover` set once per row). This branch's duplicate chip hover is dropped, so only main's row-hover highlight remains.
- In `shell.rs` the CRLF line endings match main. Ignoring line endings, the only difference from main is 3 lines: the old `hover_features` 1px line becomes `pick_ink::paint`, the stronger selected/hover strokes. Main's row-hover halo block is kept after it.
- The one-edge Ctrl/plain pick with the Shift loop (`edge_pick.rs`, `feature_click.rs`) is unchanged. Selection still goes through the existing commands (`SetOperationGeometry`). No snapshot PNG changed. The structural tests are updated (`edge_click_modifiers.rs`, 171 lines). New files are 78 and 171 lines, well under 400. The decision file now follows main's row hover.
- No conflict with current main (trial merge clean).

Results merged with main (d21d4855), on the self-hosted runner: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/43508367124
- Quick gate: ui suites ok (76s), 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

Requested before merge: none.

Not exercised / notes (not blocking)
- Before/after screenshots of the pick strokes are owed in the PR description; by the maintainer's standing answer they do not block.
- The GUI was not run, and the pixel snapshots are release-lane.
- Windows-only readings were not run (nothing cfg(windows) in the diff).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
